M4_3_FORBIDDEN_PATHS: any unlisted aota_forge/** functional source path

path_roles.aota_forge/core/ingress.py: Add execute_mutation and typed envelope handling only; preserve execute read-only behavior and do not add a generic mutation API.
path_roles.aota_forge/core/catalog.py: Register the two accepted lifecycle descriptors exactly once.
path_roles.aota_forge/core/handlers.py: Add two thin lifecycle bindings; preserve existing read handlers and bootstrap behavior.
path_roles.shared_paths: Consume accepted contracts without changing semantics.
path_roles.integration_paths: Only serial export, adapter, and end-to-end regression convergence after exclusive source review.
path_roles.forbidden_paths: No authority, lifecycle, transaction, external adapter, journal, graph-authority, or runtime activation changes.

partition_rules: The exclusive list and integration list are disjoint.
No M4-3 source change may modify an M4-2 or M4-4 exclusive path.
A shared read-only path is a consumer boundary, not an M4-3 write target.
CLI and Hermes adapters are non-exclusive and must route through the same ingress.
Tests may mutate only isolated fixtures and must be integration-owned when they cross M4-2/M4-4 seams.
